milestones.text: went out for the first time and came home already planning the next trip
milestones.post: First outing done. Already planning the second.

milestones.text: bought the wrong gear, then the right gear
milestones.post: Wrong gear, right gear. Two shopping trips, one lesson.

milestones.text: got thoroughly rained on and loved it anyway
milestones.post: Soaked to the skin. Grinning anyway.

milestones.text: tagged along with an experienced group and asked a hundred questions
milestones.post: Asked roughly a hundred questions. Everyone was very kind.

milestones.text: started keeping a log of every outing
milestones.post: Outing number one, logged. Very official.

milestones.text: got up before dawn for it, voluntarily
milestones.post: Up before dawn. On purpose. Who even am I.

milestones.text: learned to check the weather before heading out, after the first time they did not
milestones.post: Check the weather first. Noted, damply.

milestones.text: spent most of the first outing working out what they were supposed to be doing
milestones.post: Mostly confused. Still lovely.

milestones.text: went out three weekends in a row, whatever the weather
milestones.post: Three weekends running. It's a habit now.

milestones.text: found a favourite spot of their own
milestones.post: Found my spot. Not telling anyone where.

milestones.text: packed for a day out in ten minutes flat with nothing forgotten
milestones.post: Packed in ten minutes. Forgot nothing. Growth.

milestones.text: talked a friend into coming along, and the friend loved it
milestones.post: Converted a friend. Recruitment going well.

milestones.text: read the sky well enough to know when to head home early
milestones.post: Headed home before the weather turned. Felt very wise.

milestones.text: filled their first logbook from cover to cover
milestones.post: First logbook full. Starting volume two.

milestones.text: went out alone for the first time and felt completely at home
milestones.post: First solo outing. Quiet, easy, perfect.

milestones.text: left the guidebook in the bag for a whole day out
milestones.post: Didn't open the guidebook once today.

milestones.text: planned a whole trip on their own, start to finish
milestones.post: Planned it all myself. It went exactly to plan.

milestones.text: went somewhere new that the old hands had only talked about
milestones.post: Finally went to the place everyone talks about. Lived up to it.

milestones.text: was the one the group turned to when the plan changed
milestones.post: Plans changed. Everyone looked at me. I had an answer.

milestones.text: had a perfect day out they will be talking about for years
milestones.post: Today was the one. I'll be telling this story forever.

milestones.text: went out in the cold season and found it even better
milestones.post: Winter outing. Cold air, empty places, wonderful.

milestones.text: drew a map by hand of all their favourite places
milestones.post: Drew my own map. Not to scale, but mine.

milestones.text: fixed a gear problem on the spot with string and patience
milestones.post: String and patience. Fixed it on the spot.

milestones.text: started noticing small things they would have walked straight past a year ago
milestones.post: I notice so much more now. Same places, new eyes.

milestones.text: led a small group of beginners on a first outing
milestones.post: Led my first group. Everyone came home happy.

milestones.text: gave a talk about their favourite places at the local club
milestones.post: Talked for half an hour about my favourite spots. Could have gone on.

milestones.text: went on a week-long trip and came back wanting more
milestones.post: A whole week out. Coming home felt strange.

milestones.text: was asked to help plan the big group outing of the year
milestones.post: Helping plan the big trip this year. Big responsibility, big fun.

milestones.text: kept their log going for a full year with no gaps
milestones.post: One whole year of outings, no gaps.

milestones.text: taught a friend's child the basics over a long, patient afternoon
milestones.post: Taught a nine-year-old today. They were better at it than me.

milestones.text: went out in every season of the year and found a favourite in each
milestones.post: A favourite outing for every season now.

milestones.text: lent their spare gear to a newcomer, with a full walk-through
milestones.post: Kitted out a newcomer. Paying it forward.

milestones.text: had a write-up of their trips printed in the club newsletter
milestones.post: My trip write-up made the club newsletter. Front page.

milestones.text: completed the big trip they had dreamed about since they started
milestones.post: Did the dream trip. Still can't quite believe it.

milestones.text: was made an honorary guide by the local club
milestones.post: Honorary guide. They gave me a badge and everything.

milestones.text: knew the countryside well enough to be the one asked for directions
milestones.post: I'm the one people ask now. Good feeling.

milestones.text: saw something on an outing that the old hands had never seen
milestones.post: Saw something today even the old-timers hadn't. Still buzzing.

milestones.text: led the biggest group outing of the year without a hitch
milestones.post: Thirty people out, thirty home, everyone smiling.

milestones.text: counted up their outings for the year and lost count past a hundred
milestones.post: Lost count past a hundred outings this year.

milestones.text: was asked to write the beginners' guide for the local club
milestones.post: Writing the club's beginners' guide. No pressure.

milestones.text: finished their first proper trail and needed a long sit at the top
milestones.post: Made it to the top. Sat there for a long time. Worth it.

milestones.text: wore in their first pair of hiking boots on short walks around town
milestones.post: Walking round town in hiking boots. Wearing them in.

milestones.text: downloaded a trail app and followed the little dotted line the whole way
milestones.post: Followed the little blue dot all the way. Six miles!

milestones.text: finished a ten-mile loop with only one stop
milestones.post: Ten miles, one stop, one very good sandwich.

milestones.text: hiked to a summit before sunrise and watched the light come up
milestones.post: Sunrise from the summit. Worth the 4am alarm.

milestones.text: learned to use a paper map and compass, just in case the phone died
milestones.post: Map and compass, no phone. Didn't get lost once.

milestones.text: did their first overnight backpacking trip
milestones.post: First night on the trail. Stars, silence, cold toes.

milestones.text: climbed over three thousand feet in a single day
milestones.post: 3,000 feet up today. Legs say hello.

milestones.text: hiked the whole ridge trail that everyone at work talks about
milestones.post: Did the ridge. Finally see what the fuss is about.

milestones.text: finished a three-day section of a long-distance trail
milestones.post: Three days, 45 miles, one very happy hiker.

milestones.text: led a group of coworkers on a weekend hike
milestones.post: Took six coworkers up a mountain. Morale: excellent.

milestones.text: bagged their tenth peak in the region
milestones.post: Peak number ten. The list is getting shorter.

milestones.text: completed a week-long thru-hike from one end of a famous trail to the other
milestones.post: A whole trail, end to end. I'm a different person.

milestones.text: hiked every trail in the state park in a single year
milestones.post: Every trail in the park, done. Already miss the challenge.

milestones.text: was asked to lead hikes for the local hiking club
milestones.post: Official hike leader. They gave me a whistle.

milestones.text: bought a field guide and spent an evening learning the common garden birds
milestones.post: Field guide bought. Sparrows identified. Next: everything else.

milestones.text: spent an hour following a mystery bird that turned out to be a pigeon
milestones.post: Spent an hour on a mystery bird. It was a pigeon.

milestones.text: learned to hold their field glasses steady enough to actually see a bird
milestones.post: Field glasses and bird, both at once. Achievement.

milestones.text: named a bird by its song before they even saw it
milestones.post: Heard it, named it, then saw it. I was right!

milestones.text: reached fifty species on their life list
milestones.post: Fifty species! The list grows.

milestones.text: got up at dawn for the morning chorus and stayed to the end
milestones.post: The dawn chorus is a whole orchestra. Who knew.

milestones.text: tried a bird-song app and found their own ears were faster
milestones.post: Beat the app. My ears win.

milestones.text: spotted a kingfisher on the river after weeks of trying
milestones.post: A kingfisher. A flash of blue and gone. Worth every morning.

milestones.text: learned to tell the little brown warblers apart, mostly
milestones.post: I can tell the warblers apart now. Mostly. On a good day.

milestones.text: kept a notebook with a sketch beside every sighting
milestones.post: Sketches beside every sighting. My notebook is getting pretty.

milestones.text: reached two hundred species on their life list
milestones.post: Two hundred species. Each one a little story.

milestones.text: led a dawn bird walk for the local society
milestones.post: Led the dawn walk. Twelve people, thirty species.

milestones.text: took part in the annual bird count and recorded every species on their patch
milestones.post: Counted every bird on my patch for the census. Cold hands, full heart.

milestones.text: found a rare visitor that brought birders from miles around
milestones.post: Found a rarity. Fifty birders turned up by lunch.

milestones.text: had their sighting of a rare bird entered in the county records
milestones.post: My sighting is in the county records now. Official.

milestones.text: was invited to write the bird notes for the local society
milestones.post: Writing the society's bird notes this year. Honoured.

milestones.text: caught their first fish and let it go again
milestones.post: First fish! Tiny. Released. Beaming.

milestones.text: untangled their first truly hopeless knot of line
milestones.post: One hour untangling. Zero fish. Still happy.

milestones.text: tied a proper fishing knot from memory
milestones.post: Tied the knot from memory. Small step.

milestones.text: cast exactly where they meant to for a whole afternoon
milestones.post: Every cast where I wanted it. The fish disagreed, but still.

milestones.text: caught enough for supper and cooked it on the bank
milestones.post: Caught supper. Ate supper. Perfect day.

milestones.text: learned to read the water and find where the fish were resting
milestones.post: Starting to see where fish hide. Feels like a secret.

milestones.text: landed a fish big enough to need both hands
milestones.post: Two hands needed. The fish was not impressed.

milestones.text: tied their own flies and caught a trout on one
milestones.post: Caught a trout on a fly I tied myself. Unbearably proud.

milestones.text: sat out a whole grey morning and was rewarded right at the end
milestones.post: Hours of nothing, then the best catch of the year.

milestones.text: won a small fishing contest on the river
milestones.post: Won the river contest! Bragging rights for a year.

milestones.text: taught a neighbour's child to cast, right up to a first fish
milestones.post: Taught a kid to fish. Their face when it bit.

milestones.text: found a quiet pool nobody else seemed to know about
milestones.post: Found a secret pool. Keeping that one to myself.

milestones.text: landed the biggest fish anyone on the river had seen that year
milestones.post: Biggest catch on the river this year. Fish released, story kept.

milestones.text: took first place at the regional angling match
milestones.post: First place. Years of quiet mornings paid off.

milestones.text: made their own rod and caught a fine fish with it
milestones.post: Built the rod, caught the fish. Full circle.

milestones.text: pitched their first tent, eventually, with the instructions upside down
milestones.post: Tent is up. Instructions were upside down. Mostly my fault.

milestones.text: spent their first night under canvas and heard every single noise
milestones.post: Every twig snap was a bear. None were bears.

milestones.text: forgot the tent pegs on their first trip and improvised with sticks
milestones.post: Forgot pegs. Used sticks. Survived. Adventurer.

milestones.text: got a campfire going with a single match
milestones.post: One match. One fire. One very smug camper.

milestones.text: cooked pancakes for breakfast on a camp stove
milestones.post: Pancakes on a camp stove. Living the dream.

milestones.text: pitched the tent in under ten minutes
milestones.post: Tent up in nine minutes. I timed it.

milestones.text: went wild camping for the first time, far from any campsite
milestones.post: No campsite, no people, just us and the hills.

milestones.text: camped through a night of heavy rain and stayed completely dry
milestones.post: Storm all night. Bone dry inside. Great tent, better pitching.

milestones.text: packed everything for a weekend into one backpack
milestones.post: Whole weekend on my back. Lighter than I thought.

milestones.text: organised a group camping weekend for eight friends
milestones.post: Eight friends, four tents, one very long campfire.

milestones.text: camped in the snow and woke up warm
milestones.post: Snow camping. Woke up warm. The gear works!

milestones.text: taught a friend to pitch a tent and build a fire
milestones.post: Taught a friend the basics. They're hooked.

milestones.text: spent a full week camping in the backcountry with no phone signal
milestones.post: A week off-grid. My phone is very confused.

milestones.text: camped out in every season of the year
milestones.post: Spring, summer, autumn, winter. All four, under canvas.

milestones.text: was asked to lead the camping weekend for a local youth group
milestones.post: Led the youth group trip. Everyone ate, slept and laughed.

milestones.text: found their first patch of wild garlic by smell alone
milestones.post: Smelled it before I saw it. Wild garlic!

milestones.text: picked a whole basket of blackberries and ate half on the way home
milestones.post: Basket half full by the time I got home. No regrets.

milestones.text: learned the first rule: never eat anything without being certain
milestones.post: Rule one: if in doubt, leave it out.

milestones.text: learned five edible mushrooms well enough to be certain of them
milestones.post: Five mushrooms I know for certain. Starting slow.

milestones.text: made a pot of jam from berries they picked themselves
milestones.post: Hedgerow jam. Free, wild and delicious.

milestones.text: found a stand of elderflowers and made a cordial
milestones.post: Elderflower cordial from my own patch. Summer in a bottle.

milestones.text: found their first chanterelles and kept the spot a secret
milestones.post: Chanterelles! The spot is secret. Don't ask.

milestones.text: cooked a whole meal from what they gathered in one morning
milestones.post: Gathered it this morning. Cooked it tonight. Ate like royalty.

milestones.text: learned the seasons well enough to know what is ripe each month
milestones.post: I know what's ripe each month now. The woods are a calendar.

milestones.text: led a small foraging walk for friends
milestones.post: Took four friends foraging. They found more than me.

milestones.text: filled the pantry with dried mushrooms for the winter
milestones.post: Pantry stocked with mushrooms for winter. Feeling like a squirrel.

milestones.text: found a morel patch after three springs of searching
milestones.post: Three springs of looking. Morels at last.

milestones.text: was asked by the cook at the inn to supply wild mushrooms
milestones.post: Supplying mushrooms to the inn now. Official forager.

milestones.text: could name almost every plant on the woodland path at a glance
milestones.post: Walked the path and named everything. Felt like a wizard.

milestones.text: found a rare mushroom the old foragers had only heard about
milestones.post: Found the one the old-timers talk about. Left it be.

milestones.text: found the Plough and the North Star for the first time
milestones.post: Found the North Star. Feel slightly less lost in the universe.

milestones.text: stayed out late enough on a clear night to see the Milky Way
milestones.post: The Milky Way, with my own eyes. Speechless.

milestones.text: learned to let their eyes adjust to the dark for a full twenty minutes
milestones.post: Twenty minutes of dark. Then a thousand more stars.

milestones.text: named a dozen constellations without a chart
milestones.post: Twelve constellations, no chart. The sky is less of a stranger.

milestones.text: watched a meteor shower and counted forty shooting stars
milestones.post: Forty shooting stars. Wished on all of them.

milestones.text: spotted Jupiter and knew it for a planet, not a star
milestones.post: That bright 'star'? Jupiter. I knew it!

milestones.text: saw the rings of Saturn through a telescope for the first time
milestones.post: Saturn has rings. I saw them. Myself. Tonight.

milestones.text: picked out the moons of Jupiter through a small telescope
milestones.post: Four tiny dots beside Jupiter. Moons!

milestones.text: drew a careful star chart of the summer sky
milestones.post: Drew my own star chart. Nerdy and proud.

milestones.text: found a spot far from any lights and went back every clear night
milestones.post: Found the darkest spot around. Going back every clear night.

milestones.text: showed friends the craters of the moon through a telescope
milestones.post: Friends saw the craters. Everyone said 'wow' at once.

milestones.text: followed a comet across the sky for a whole week
milestones.post: A comet! Watched it every night this week.

milestones.text: taught a group of children to find the constellations
milestones.post: Taught the kids the constellations. They called it the sky map game.

milestones.text: hosted a public stargazing night with a line at the telescope
milestones.post: Fifty people queued for the telescope. The sky put on a show.

milestones.text: could name the brightest stars of every season by heart
milestones.post: Every season's bright stars, by heart.

milestones.text: found the faint glow of the Orion Nebula after years of trying
milestones.post: The Orion Nebula, a smudge of glow. Years to find, worth it.

milestones.text: watched a total eclipse they had planned for years
milestones.post: Totality. Planned for years. Over in minutes. Unforgettable.

milestones.text: paddled in a straight line for the first time, briefly
milestones.post: Straight line for almost a minute. Proud.

milestones.text: took their first beginner's lesson at the lake
milestones.post: First lesson. Mostly went in circles. Loved it.

milestones.text: practised a capsize drill and came up laughing
milestones.post: Capsized on purpose. Came up laughing. Weirdly fun.

milestones.text: paddled across the whole lake and back
milestones.post: Across the lake and back. Arms feel like noodles.

milestones.text: learned to lean the kayak into a smooth turn
milestones.post: Smooth turn! Didn't even wobble.

milestones.text: bought their own secondhand kayak
milestones.post: Got my own kayak. Secondhand, perfect.

milestones.text: rolled the kayak back upright for the first time
milestones.post: Rolled it! Upside down, then right side up. Amazing.

milestones.text: paddled ten miles down the river in an afternoon
milestones.post: Ten miles of river. Herons the whole way.

milestones.text: went sea kayaking along the coast
milestones.post: Sea kayaking. Seals followed us for a while.

milestones.text: led a group paddle for beginners on the lake
milestones.post: Led the beginners' paddle. No one capsized. Mostly.

milestones.text: paddled through their first stretch of easy whitewater
milestones.post: First whitewater. Yelled a little. Happy yelling.

milestones.text: paddled out to an island and camped there overnight
milestones.post: Paddled to an island and slept there. Childhood dream.

milestones.text: completed a three-day paddle down the length of the river
milestones.post: Three days, whole river, one kayak. Done.

milestones.text: won their age group in a local kayak race
milestones.post: Won my age group! First race medal ever.

milestones.text: became an assistant instructor at the paddling club
milestones.post: Assistant instructor now. Teaching the roll.

milestones.text: landed a first fish without help
milestones.post: First fish. Small. Counts.

milestones.text: learned to tie a knot that holds
milestones.post: The knot held!

milestones.text: learned the best spot on the river
milestones.post: Found the spot.

milestones.text: caught enough for supper
milestones.post: Supper, caught.

milestones.text: landed a fish too big for the basket
milestones.post: Too big for the basket!

milestones.text: caught fish on a day nobody else did
milestones.post: Only one catching today.

milestones.text: was asked for advice by an old angler
milestones.post: An old angler asked ME.

milestones.text: landed the biggest fish seen on the river in years
milestones.post: Biggest in years.

milestones.text: learned to find the north star
milestones.post: North star, found.

milestones.text: named five constellations without help
milestones.post: Five constellations, named.

milestones.text: watched a whole meteor shower until dawn
milestones.post: Shooting stars till dawn.

milestones.text: learned to tell a planet from a star by its steady light
milestones.post: Planets don't twinkle.

milestones.text: drew a chart of the night sky from their own watching
milestones.post: My own star chart.

milestones.text: told the seasons by the stars alone
milestones.post: Seasons in the stars.

milestones.text: was sought out by travellers wanting to know the stars
milestones.post: Travellers ask me the way by the stars.

milestones.text: learned to tell three safe mushrooms apart
milestones.post: Three safe ones, learned.

milestones.text: came home with a full basket
milestones.post: Full basket.

milestones.text: found a patch of wild garlic nobody else knew about
milestones.post: Secret garlic patch.

milestones.text: learned the hedgerows well enough to forage all year
milestones.post: Something to find every season.

milestones.text: made a whole meal from what they gathered
milestones.post: Dinner, all foraged.

milestones.text: was asked to identify a find by a worried neighbour
milestones.post: Saved a neighbour a bellyache.

milestones.text: knew every wild food within a day's walk
milestones.post: Every wild food for miles.

sessions.text: Came home with cold cheeks and a clear head.
Brought a flask and a small snack, which made all the difference.
Didn't see much, but the quiet was worth it.
Jotted a few notes in the logbook afterwards.
Watched the light change for a while before heading home.
Had the place almost to themselves.
Kept a steady pace on the trail.
Stopped at the top for a long look at the view.
Ticked off a few familiar birds in the notebook.
Stood very still while a little flock passed overhead.
Spent a peaceful hour by the water, bite or no bite.
Changed the bait twice and finally got a nibble.
Checked over the tent and repacked the gear for next time.
Came back with a small basket and muddy boots.
Waited for the clouds to clear and was rewarded with a patch of stars.
Paddled out to the middle and just floated for a while.
